rule_or_pattern: ASCII double quote used as a spacing breathing+accent before a capital vowel: '"' followed by [ΑΕΗΙΟΥΩ] at word start -> the precomposed capital with psili+oxia (e.g. '"Αφησε' -> 'Ἄφησε', '"Αλογα' -> 'Ἄλογα'; regex (?<![\w])"(?=[ΑΕΗΙΟΥΩ])). Also drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out, and lines starting with a drop capital (label begins with a lone Latin 'H').
notes: This is a 1916 polytonic demotic short-story collection. Readings are accurate throughout (1-40), including breathings, accents, 'κ᾿' and 'τ᾿' elisions; the low katharevousa score is just demotic register. The systematic fault is the capital with smooth breathing+acute (Ἄ), printed as a spacing mark: Google sometimes writes it as an ASCII '"' (5 '"Αφησε', 7 '"Αλογα') instead of ῎ (23, 24), and the pool rule for ᾿Α would miss the ASCII form. Line 29 has a label from another line, and 39 reads the drop-cap 'Ἤτανε' as Latin 'H'.
